title: Kiritani Haruka — Producer Studies〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find a cute tablecloth!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to using it during our next tea party stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were also able to buy snacks to introduce during it, so that means we got everything we wanted to pick out, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, we'll break off here like we discussed. Remember to meet back up at the MORE MORE HOUSE an hour before our stream, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Okay.
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori and I will be buying essentials for the MORE MORE HOUSE, so let us know if you'd like us to get anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll be over at the CD shop gathering information on all the idols participating in the Lumina Grand Prix.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're headed over to the library, right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm hoping to find books on management techniques and being a producer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going through their online catalog, I found that they carry a lot of books that aren't sold in stores.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll also be keeping an eye out for any that may help us with our training and practices.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds like quite a lot...
Thank you for being so diligent.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's meet back up in a bit.
A few hours later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm glad I was able to borrow these books.
But it doesn't look like the others are back yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll take this opportunity to flip through some of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But which one do I read first?
I borrowed so many that I'm not sure...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, how about this one? It's by the producer who created Afternoon Girls...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I should be able to learn a lot since it discusses the fundamentals of being a producer, as well as how to apply those skills.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And this one is a beginner's guide to managing talent. While this one is a business book centered around marketing...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (“Exercise Encyclopedia: How To Achieve The Perfect Body” seems worthy of its title. It had a lot of exercises that I'd never heard of before.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (MEIKO's also going to be interested in this one, so we could look through it and come up with new workouts together sometime.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, and then there's...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(“The World's Top 100 Baby Penguins”...
I'll read this during my next break.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll start with that beginner's guide...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're back!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome back.
Thanks for getting those things for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shopping with Minori was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where's Airi? Is she not back yet...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, she might not be back for a bit. She did say she'd be visiting several shops.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. Then, let's start putting away the cleaning supplies and stuff while we wait.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. We can also start preparing for our stream at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
You want to use this time to learn more about being a producer, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We don't have to prepare much, so you can leave it to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, I'll keep reading.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll go over and start getting the streaming room ready, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll be right over once I finish refilling everything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... Here are the replacement dusters... And here are the wet wipes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Minori? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I couldn't help but watch you as you read that book. The way you're focusing is just so picturesque...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now that your energy has recharged my battery, Haruka, I'm gonna put everything away and get ready for our stream! Whoo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what she meant by that, but I guess I'm glad she's more motivated now...?)
